candidate_relations.reason: The reference is clear cell sarcoma, supported by melanocytic marker expression and absent epidermal junctional activity. A dermal Bednar tumor is a distinct fibroblastic neoplasm and typically contains melanin-bearing dendritic cells, whereas no melanin pigment was identified here.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Bednar tumor is a pigmented variant of dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans, not clear cell sarcoma.
